question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.
sql:
WITH seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price,
        COUNT(*) as quantity_sold
    FROM order_items oi
    WHERE oi.seller_id IN (
        SELECT seller_id 
        FROM order_items 
        GROUP BY seller_id 
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
    )
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_reviews AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(ov.review_score) as avg_review_score
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN order_reviews ov ON oi.order_id = ov.order_id
    WHERE oi.seller_id IN (
        SELECT seller_id 
        FROM order_items 
        GROUP BY seller_id 
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
    )
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN d.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL THEN 
                    (date(d.order_approved_at) - date(d.order_purchase_timestamp)) * 24
                ELSE NULL 
            END
        ) as avg_packing_hours
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders d ON oi.order_id = d.order_id
    WHERE oi.seller_id IN (
        SELECT seller_id 
        FROM order_items 
        GROUP BY seller_id 
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
    )
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pct.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.price) as category_sales
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
    WHERE oi.seller_id IN (
        SELECT seller_id 
        FROM order_items 
        GROUP BY seller_id 
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
    )
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pct.product_category_name_english
),
top_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        product_category_name_english,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY category_sales DESC) as rn
    FROM seller_categories
)
SELECT 
    sm.seller_id,
    sm.total_sales,
    sm.avg_item_price,
    COALESCE(sr.avg_review_score, 0) as avg_review_score,
    COALESCE(sp.avg_packing_hours, 0) as avg_packing_hours,
    tc.product_category_name_english as top_category_english
FROM seller_metrics sm
LEFT JOIN seller_reviews sr ON sm.seller_id = sr.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_packing sp ON sm.seller_id = sp.seller_id
LEFT JOIN top_categories tc ON sm.seller_id = tc.seller_id AND tc.rn = 1
ORDER BY sm.total_sales DESC
